name: Gold risk-off x crypto weakness — fade the continuation (perp short)
rationale: CROSS-MARKET REGIME, SHORT leg (perp; direction=-1). Gold is the canonical risk-off / real-rate hedge: a sharp gold rally is capital fleeing TO safety, a macro risk-off signal that historically coincides with high-beta risk assets (crypto) bleeding. The existing cross-market specs are all LONG (dollar-weak momentum, NDX-up momentum). This is the orthogonal short: when gold is in a risk-off surge AND crypto momentum is already NEGATIVE, the cross-market regime confirms the down-move has macro fuel and is likely to continue rather than bounce — so we fade it with a perp short. Mechanism before data: short when gold_xau crosses UP through a fitted risk-off level (safety bid, read via the direction of the cross since the raw level is non-stationary) AND crypto ret over a window is negative (the weakness is already in price); stop ABOVE entry, take-profit BELOW; exit when crypto momentum turns back up (regime relief). Distinct from every long cross-market spec and from the funding/basis SHORTS (those are crowding-unwind, not a macro-regime confirmation). Disconfirmer 1: drop the gold arm — if bare negative-momentum shorting matches the deflated Sharpe, the gold risk-off regime adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: gold and crypto are only weakly/inconsistently correlated; if the edge is identical with gold REMOVED or REPLACED by silver, the specific gold-risk-off read is not load-bearing. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): gold is daily next-day-available (Stooq); a perp short pays/earns funding (funding_feature set) and must clear ~20bps+ net. tier0 gold_xau + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS; SHORT requires perp (not spot-executable on Binance spot).
catalyst: gold_xau crosses up into a risk-off surge WHILE crypto momentum is negative — a macro-confirmed down-continuation, faded with a perp short
